name: Venezuela
description: Venezuela from its Indigenous peoples to Spanish rule, Bolívar and independence, oil, Chávez and the crisis of today.

checkpoints.name: Before Spain
checkpoints.note: Many Indigenous peoples lived on the coast, in the Andes and on the plains.

checkpoints.name: Colony
checkpoints.note: Columbus reached the coast in 1498, and Spain founded Caracas in 1567.

checkpoints.name: Independence
checkpoints.note: Venezuela declared independence in 1811, and Bolívar led the war. Strongmen ruled for a century.

checkpoints.name: Oil
checkpoints.note: Oil was struck in 1914. Democracy came in 1958, Chávez in 1999, and economic collapse under Maduro drove millions abroad.
